items.title: RESCIND – PERPENDICULAR PARKING ESTABLISH – PARALLEL PARKING Connecticut Street, west side, from 129 feet to 165 feet south of 26th Street (Supervisor District 10) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Edward Tang, [staff email removed — see the order]
items.approver: Requires approval by the SFMTA Board
items.decision: Noted typo on the public hearing agenda regarding the CEQA clearance date, which is December 2, 2024 and not March 12, 2025 as indicated on the agenda. Item will be brought back to a future public hearing with a modification in the proposal.
items.comments: Received several emails in opposition, citing concerns about parking loss, prior to public hearing. Comment received during public hearing regarding outreach, street width and existing parking time limit regulation.
items.text:
8. RESCIND – PERPENDICULAR PARKING
ESTABLISH – PARALLEL PARKING
Connecticut Street, west side, from 129 feet to 165 feet south of 26th Street (Supervisor District 10)
(Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Edward Tang, [staff email removed — see the order]



Proposal to convert perpendicular parking to parallel parking due to sidewalk construction at 1920
Cesar Chavez.

Public Comments: Received several emails in opposition, citing concerns about parking loss, prior to
public hearing. Comment received during public hearing regarding outreach, street width and
existing parking time limit regulation.
Decision: Noted typo on the public hearing agenda regarding the CEQA clearance date, which is
December 2, 2024 and not March 12, 2025 as indicated on the agenda.
Item will be brought back to a future public hearing with a modification in the proposal.
